nom: APRILSKIN TXA Pink Capsule Gel Mask

segments.sensitive: Reports are split: two reviewers with sensitive skin found the formula too harsh, causing redness or a breakout, and recommend a patch test first; another reviewer with sensitive skin instead found it soothing with no stinging or irritation.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including a couple in their 50s, report the mask delivers strong hydration and leaves skin visibly plumper and smoother.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature or aging skin, including one who calls her under-eye bags and wrinkles hereditary and otherwise unresponsive to skincare, report visible improvements — reduced puffiness, plumper skin and a fresher look — that other products hadn't achieved for them.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with visible signs of aging, including crow's feet, jowls, and under-eye puffiness, report the mask leaves skin plumper and fresher-looking; one reviewer says it noticeably reduced long-standing under-eye bags that other high-end products hadn't touched.
concerns.dehydration: This is the most consistently reported benefit: nearly all reviewers describe strong, immediate hydration that leaves skin plump, soft and glass-like, often lasting into the next day.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers report the mask caused redness, irritation or a burning sensation on their skin, while others, including one who calls her skin sensitive, report zero stinging or sensitivity; a patch test is recommended by more than one reviewer.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers credit the tranexamic acid (TXA) formula with brighter, more even-looking skin tone after use, describing their complexion as noticeably more even and radiant.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with typically clear skin reports an unprecedented breakout after a single use, and another found the formula too harsh for her own skin though it worked well for her acne-prone sister; other reviewers report no breakouts and even a calming effect.

aspects.libelle: Two-piece thicker gel that stays in place well
Some units arrive torn, jumbled or with a broken seal
Pricier than typical sheet masks for fewer per pack
Light fragrance (strawberry, bubblegum) most find pleasant
Considered good value next to similar premium brands

extraits.titre: Great Glow Mask, Even If You Don’t Sleep in ItGreat Glow Mask, Even If You Don’t Sleep in It
extraits.texte: At 52, post-menopausal, with mature dry skin, I’m always interested in products that can give a quick boost of hydration and help my skin look fresher. This mask has been a really good one for that. Personally, I don’t love wearing masks overnight. I’m a stomach sleeper, so anything sitting on my face while I sleep usually ends up uncomfortable or disturbed by morning. Because of that, I use this differently than the directions suggest—and it still works beautifully for me. I apply it while I’m home relaxing and leave it on until it turns clear, which usually takes a couple of hours. That gives me the benefits without trying to sleep in it, and honestly I prefer using it that way. What I like most is the visible payoff. My skin looks more hydrated, smoother, and noticeably glowier afterward. It gives that fresh, well-rested look people often want from overnight masks, but you don’t necessarily have to wear it overnight to get there. The formula includes TXA (tranexamic acid), an ingredient often used in skincare aimed at uneven tone and dullness, along with hydrating ingredients that help plump the skin and improve overall radiance. I see this more as a glow and hydration treatment than a dramatic correction product. Who is this best for? Dry skin, dull skin, mature skin, anyone wanting that glass-skin look, or people who enjoy at-home treatment masks before an event or night out. Who may not love it?
